defects.what: The large decorative year panel constrains the bullet column, producing awkward short continuation lines, including an isolated 'sales'.
The first number nearly reaches its card's right edge, while 312 sits visibly higher than the other statistics.

BHPS.craft_notes: Warm serif typography in the PDF and a consistent palette give character, but the content slides need better line breaking and optical alignment. PPTX views substitute the PDF's serif face; renderer/font availability limits certainty about appearance in the three named applications. Editable text, chart values and three-sentence notes checked; all round-1 views and crops inspected.
BHPS.revision_notes: Total and Q4 updated in slides, native chart and notes; the new quote follows slide 2, includes notes and matches the card style. Numbering updated to seven.

defects.where: r1 deck.pptx slide 2 and content-slide rules
defects.what: Visible drop shadows on thin rules and card borders add a muddy edge to an otherwise flat graphic system; the PDF is cleaner.

YYIO.craft_notes: Clear, readable statistics and bullet slides with consistent margins and a useful highlighted peak quarter. The generic circles and stripes give limited café character. Native chart, editable text and three-sentence notes checked; all round-1 views and crops inspected. PowerPoint, Keynote and Google Slides themselves were not available to verify interoperability.
YYIO.revision_notes: Both deliverables show 35,630 and Q4 9,250, with notes updated and chart emphasis moved to the new peak. The correctly positioned quote slide has matching styling and three-sentence notes.

pairwise_round1.why: YYIO has more even statistic alignment and cleaner, easier-to-read bullet layouts, despite BHPS's more distinctive PDF typography.
